set.body:
Completion epic for the remaining relational scientific workflows, not a request to rebuild the delivered pairing core. PRD C-9, X-1 through X-17, DET-4, V-4, V-7 and V-9 remain normative.

Delivered foundation (retain existing closed children and their evidence):
Trials with typed keys/opaque metadata; structural Relation and legal PairDesign values; indexed equality joins; shared exhaustive between/within scheduling; explicit self/orientation policies; duplicate and unmatched diagnostics; keyed bottom-k controls; edge-level results, typed reductions and contrasts; relation/sampling conformance and cross-runtime RNG evidence. The direct repetition facade and exhaustive saved two-phase study workflow also exist.

Remaining acceptance:
1. Surface models and partial association — bd-01KYD6SYK02ZRV99MG7FX939ZS. A non-empty nominal PredictorSet of Mass surfaces; OLS fits Signed, intercept-free NNLS fits Intensity, simplex-constrained fits Mass, and residuals remain Signed. Explicit intercept policy and descriptive diagnostics; no invalid per-cell coefficient inference. Partial Pearson/Spearman association is a distinct operation. The scalar fixed-feature R fitting bridge does not satisfy this requirement.
2. Repetition breadth and persistence — eyesim-repetition. Complete required repetition methods and multiscale mean/none behavior. Persist named all-occasion projections and finite-cap controls, retaining participant/stimulus/occasion scope, self policy, seed/sample identity, pair identities, failures and realized denominators. Prove direct-versus-restored scientific results and provenance.
3. Relational conformance — evidence delivered with the two children above and retained core suites. Use independent analytic/exhaustive oracles, pinned eyesim references for shared relational conventions, explicit justified divergences, mutation checks where appropriate, and portable JVM/Scala.js tests. Equality on shared estimands is not required where an intentional scientific convention differs.

Exit:
Both remaining implementation children are complete; public surface-model/partial-association and repetition workflows are documented and executable; direct and saved forms agree within the explicitly supported persistence scope; relevant relational baseline cases have no unexplained discrepancies. Preserve exact identity checks and named numerical tolerances. Do not close from symbol presence or a subset of methods alone.

Boundary:
Whole-library eyesim parity remains v-parity under bd-01M214CX2CTADNR6Q9D032Y1FB. Unrelated KDE, density transforms, scanpath, entropy, raw temporal-sampling and export gaps do not gate this relational epic merely through v-parity. Their baseline obligations remain unchanged. No replacement framework, GUI or new general-purpose dataframe dependency.

Next concrete work: surface decomposition and partial association. Keep this integration epic open, P0 and unassigned while its bounded children are implemented.
set.title: Complete relational workflows: surface models, repetition persistence, and conformance
